params.sql: WITH elems AS (SELECT EntityIndex, Category FROM EntityText WHERE Category IN ('IFCWALL','IFCSLAB','IFCMEMBER','IFCPLATE','IFCCOLUMN','IFCDOOR','IFCWINDOW','IFCCOVERING','IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY','IFCFURNITURE','IFCLIGHTFIXTURE','IFCRAILING','IFCSTAIR','IFCROOF')), placed AS (SELECT DISTINCT EntityIndexA FROM RelationText WHERE RelationType = 'ContainedIn') SELECT e.Category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.EntityIndexA IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS placed_pct, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN p.EntityIndexA IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unplaced FROM elems e LEFT JOIN placed p ON p.EntityIndexA = e.EntityIndex GROUP BY e.Category ORDER BY placed_pct ASC

WITH elems AS (SELECT EntityIndex, Category, Type FROM EntityText WHERE Category IN ('IFCWALL','IFCSLAB','IFCMEMBER','IFCPLATE','IFCCOLUMN','IFCDOOR','IFCWINDOW','IFCCOVERING','IFCBUILDINGELEMENTPROXY','IFCRAILING','IFCSTAIR','IFCROOF')), vol AS (SELECT DISTINCT EntityIndex FROM ParameterText WHERE Name = 'Volume' AND ValueType = 'Number') SELECT e.Category, SUM(CASE WHEN v.EntityIndex IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_volume, SUM(CASE WHEN e.Type IS NULL OR e.Type = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS untyped, COUNT(*) AS total FROM elems e LEFT JOIN vol v ON v.EntityIndex = e.EntityIndex GROUP BY e.Category HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN v.EntityIndex IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN e.Type IS NULL OR e.Type = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY missing_volume DESC
